visual_requirements.description: Mature dark-bearded regal male with bird-tipped sceptre, standard human anatomy, opaque robe.
Closes underworld gate, physically securing the dead; no invented elemental magic.

depicted_variant: Aidoneus, dark-bearded king wielding bird-tipped sceptre in his underground palace.
aura: Authority over closed underworld gates (hades-c16), visible bird-tipped sceptre and regal darkness (hades-c13).
artistic_choices: Opaque charcoal wool robes and antique gold trim are editorial attire.
Tight low-angle framing conveys authority without inventing gigantic stature.
No magical aura; physical gate closure embodies the documented domain.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of Hades, ancient Greek king of the dead.
ANATOMY: one mature dark-bearded regal male, one head, two eyes, two arms and two legs, fully opaque charcoal robes, bird-tipped sceptre held in one hand [hades-c13,hades-c32].
POWER: keep the heavy stone gates of the underworld closed so no shade escapes; no elemental magic [hades-c16].
SCALE & CAMERA: very low camera close to his figure; head and sceptre unmistakable at thumbnail size; no invented giant size.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one warm oil-lamp source low at the gate, deep shadows, dust falling from physical closing stonework.
SURFACE: dense woven cloth, rough ancient stone, dark textured beard, worn metal.
SETTING: dark underground palace and ebony throne [hades-c07,hades-c33].
MOOD: pitiless commanding authority, dangerous and overwhelming, never ordinary, neutral, decorative or cute.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text or pseudo-lettering ANYWHERE, no glyphs on pillars/clothing/metal, no logo, border, frame, watermark; no extra limbs/fingers, no film/game/anime/comic designs, no nudity or gore, no generic aura, neon or ribbons.
MOMENT: He surges forward from the throne and drives his bird-tipped sceptre down beside the gate, which is visibly slamming closed behind his shoulder. Three-quarter confrontational close view, face fills upper third.
candidate_choice_notes: All seven Sangar checks yes: dominating severe dark-bearded king, bird sceptre readable at thumbnail, stepping/closing gate action and falling dust (hades-c16), standard anatomy, no lettering or aura, regal authority. Alternate: stronger face close-up. Action less explicit than B.
